recipe_version.title: Cottage Pie with Thyme Gravy
recipe_version.description: Ground beef simmered with onion, carrot, celery, and peas in a glossy thyme gravy, topped with buttery mashed potatoes raked into ridges and baked until the peaks are golden and crisp.

ingredients.name: kosher salt
ingredients.note: 1 tbsp for the potato water, 1 tsp for the beef, 1/2 tsp for the mash

ingredients.name: unsalted butter
ingredients.note: 4 tbsp for the mash, 1 tbsp to dot the top. Milk allergen.

ingredients.name: fresh thyme
ingredients.note: about 1 tbsp leaves for the gravy plus a few leaves to finish

steps.title: Prep and start the potatoes
steps.body: Peel the potatoes, cut into 1 1/2-inch chunks, and put them in a large pot with cold water to cover by 1 inch and 1 tbsp salt. Dice the onion, carrots, and celery; mince the garlic; strip the thyme leaves (keep a pinch for the top). Set the potato pot over high heat at the end of prep.

steps.title: Cook the potatoes
steps.body: Bring the potatoes to a boil, about 10 minutes, then simmer until a knife slides in with no resistance, 12 to 15 minutes. Drain well and return to the hot pot for 1 minute to steam dry.

steps.title: Brown the beef
steps.body: Meanwhile, heat the oil in a 12-inch oven-safe skillet over medium-high. Add the beef and 1 tsp salt, break it up, and cook until well browned with crusty bits, about 8 minutes. Spoon off all but about 1 tbsp of fat.

steps.title: Soften the vegetables
steps.body: Reduce the heat to medium. Add the onion, carrots, and celery and cook, stirring, until softened, about 6 minutes. Add the garlic and tomato paste and cook 2 minutes, until the paste darkens.

steps.title: Make the thyme gravy
steps.body: Sprinkle the flour over the beef and stir 1 minute. Stir in the broth, Worcestershire, thyme leaves, bay leaf, and pepper, scraping up the browned bits. Simmer until the gravy is glossy and coats a spoon, about 10 minutes. At the start of this simmer, heat the oven to 400 F with a rack in the upper-middle position. Off the heat, remove the bay leaf and stir in the frozen peas.

steps.title: Mash
steps.body: Warm the milk (about 45 seconds in the microwave). Mash the potatoes with 4 tbsp butter, the warm milk, and 1/2 tsp salt until smooth and fluffy.

steps.title: Top
steps.body: Spoon the mash over the filling, starting at the edges to seal it in, then spread to cover. Drag a fork across the top to make deep ridges. Dot with the remaining 1 tbsp butter.

steps.title: Bake, broil, and rest
steps.body: Set the skillet on a rimmed sheet pan and bake until the gravy bubbles at the edges, about 20 minutes. Switch to broil and broil until the ridges are golden-brown and crisp, 2 to 3 minutes, watching closely. Rest 8 minutes so the gravy sets, scatter with the reserved thyme leaves, and serve in scoops. kitchen_tested is false.

components.name: beef and vegetables in thyme gravy

recipe_version.time_clock: Prep 15. Cook 66 = 8 brown beef + 8 vegetables, garlic, and paste + 11 flour and gravy simmer (oven preheats during it) + 4 mash finish + 4 top + 20 bake + 3 broil + 8 rest. Potatoes run from cook minute 0 to about 25 (10 to boil + 15 simmer) in parallel with the filling.
recipe_version.heat: High to boil the potatoes, then a simmer; medium-high to brown the beef, medium for vegetables and gravy; oven 400 F, then broil.
recipe_version.doneness: Gravy glossy and coating a spoon; bubbling at the edges after baking. Mash ridges golden-brown and crisp. Beef cooked through (160 F). kitchen_tested is false.
